summary: Scans a strided float array rooted at this+0x90 and returns how many of its first 8 elements are greater than 0.0, capped at 4. The walk advances by 23 dwords (92 bytes) per element, so the function reads one float from every 92-byte slice of a larger caller-owned structure; once 4 positive values are seen the scan stops early. Structural twin of FindActivePhysicsChannelByIndex (0045b580).

operations.description: Seed the positive counter (v1) and the iteration counter (v2) to 0 and point v3 at the first element, this + 36 dwords which is byte offset this+0x90.
do-while walk over 8 elements of the strided float array starting at this+0x90.
When the current element is greater than 0.0, increment the positive counter; break out of the walk as soon as it reaches 4.
Advance to the next element by adding 23 dwords (92 bytes) to the element pointer and increment the iteration counter each pass, stopping after 8 iterations.
Return the number of positive values found, between 0 and 4.

Called from UI cursor selection rendering (0x0045B660), collision damage decay (0x0045B840), collision penalty scaling (0x0045BE00) and sub_45B5C0, all consistent with reading per-slice state values on caller-owned structures.
